Unlock Your Pet's Full Potential with Dr. Julie Peterson. Are your pets enjoying the best quality of life? Explore the remarkable advantages of animal chiropractic care and provide your cherished pets with the present of enhanced well-being and vitality. 

Dr. Julie Peterson’s Animal Chiropractic Clinic is located in Lakewood Wa. The Barn is located in Thurston County, and she will travel locally for 3 horses+

7504 86th St Sw Suite 150, Lakewood, Washington 98498
